Account.title: An account is optional
Account.text: Tasks, solutions and tests work without an account; an unfinished test stays in this browser. With an account, history, mistakes and stats are kept on every device.
Account.stores: Sign-in is Google only. We keep your name, email and profile photo, your answers and results, and for the session your IP address and browser.
Account.privacy: What we store and how to delete your account

Privacy.title: Privacy
Privacy.account: Account: the name, email and profile photo from your Google account, that account's ID and the Google sign-in tokens.
Privacy.session: Session: the IP address and browser you sign in from.
Privacy.progress: Progress: answers, correctness, hints used and time per task, tests including an unfinished one, saved tasks.
Privacy.why: We use it only to sign you in and keep your history, mistakes and stats on every device.
Privacy.googleOnly: Sign-in is Google only; we store no passwords.
Privacy.guest: We check answers but don't store them on the server. An unfinished test stays only in this browser (localStorage); clearing site data removes it.
Privacy.tracking: No ads, analytics or trackers. Cookies only keep you signed in and remember your language.
Privacy.delete: Deleting removes your account, sessions and all progress right away. Error reports stay, with no link to you.
Privacy.contact: Questions and requests: the project's <link>GitHub issues</link>. Everything there is public, so don't post your email or other personal details.
Privacy.signedOut: If you have an account, sign in to delete it. Without an account we store nothing on the server.
Privacy.confirm: Your account, history and stats will be gone for good. This can't be undone.
Privacy.stale: For safety, sign in with Google again first, then delete your account.
Privacy.deleted: Your account and progress are deleted.
